ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white) to 35% low-intensity (dark) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous region across the central lobes. Low-intensity (black) pigmentation is concentrated along the entire trailing edge boundary and the central peduncle area. Significant high-contrast mottling is observed at the interior margins of both lobes where dark and light regions interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serrations are concentrated on the distal tip of the right lobe (viewer perspective). The remainder of the trailing edge exhibits medium-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent vertical dark linear mark is located on the inner-mid section of the right lobe. Smaller, fainter horizontal linear disruptions are visible near the central peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tip of the right lobe (viewer perspective) shows significant irregular topography suggestive of past tissue loss or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct vertical dark stripe on the right lobe contrast-mapped against the primary white surface.
